subject: Post-show reconciliation: Sponsor pipeline variance (NovaHealth)
messages:
From: Cara Lin <cara.lin@novahealth.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Rajesh Kumar <rajesh.k@novahealth.io>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodai.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discrepancy in post-show pipeline credit from May 6-7 roadshow

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the booth support at our Bay Area Health Roadshow. We were excited to sponsor and saw strong engagement. However, after tying our CRM opportunities back to the event, our RevOps team is seeing ~18 opportunities attributed to the event, while your postshow report lists only 9. That delta matters for our co-sell credit and our internal ROI calc.

Can you share the raw mapping you used to attribute leads to the show (UTM -> lead -> opp) and the logic for lead-to-opportunity matching? We ran a quick diff and the email addresses for ~7 leads that we believe came from the booth are not present in your exported list.

We need this reconciled by Thursday so our finance team can close the month. Happy to hop on a short call.

Best,
Cara Lin
Head of Demand, NovaHealth
cara.lin@novahealth.io
+1 415-555-0182
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>
To: Cara Lin <cara.lin@novahealth.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodai.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discrepancy in post-show pipeline credit from May 6-7 roadshow

Hi Cara — appreciate the heads up and sorry for the stress. Monica and I are on it.

Quick context on our end: our post-show pipeline extraction uses registered badge data + lead-qr scans as the canonical source and then joins to emails observed in our event form and session sign-ups. We then apply a 45-day lookback window for opportunity creation to attribute to an event. It's possible that a subset of your CRM-opportunity mappings used wider touch attribution or different email canonicalization (e.g., personal+tagged emails).

I attached the CSV export from our post-show import (redwood_postshow_summary_May2026.csv) which lists the 9 opps and the matched lead sources. Can you share your sample of the 7 missing emails so we can diff? If easier, let's book a 30-min sync tomorrow morning.

- Ben

Ben Carter | Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodai.com | +1 206-555-0124
From: Rajesh Kumar <rajesh.k@novahealth.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Cara Lin <cara.lin@novahealth.io>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 08:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discrepancy in post-show pipeline credit from May 6-7 roadshow

On Mon, May 18, 2026 at 10:03 AM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com> wrote:
> I attached the CSV export from our post-show import (redwood_postshow_summary_May2026.csv) which lists the 9 opps and the matched lead sources. Can you share your sample of the 7 missing emails so we can diff?

Thanks Ben. Attaching our CSV extract (novahealth_crm_export_May2026.csv). The seven we flagged are in the sheet named "Suspected Event Leads". A few observations from our side:
- Two of the emails are company alias addresses (info@, contact@) which may have been collapsed or discarded by your import rules.
- One opp was created by an inbound SDR follow-up 3 days after the show — we tagged it as "event influenced" in our tracking, not strictly event-registered.

We are flexible on the final rule set, but need a consistent reconciliation for sponsor reporting. Can you propose a deterministic mapping or a manual make-good if we can't reconcile automatically?

-Rajesh
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodai.com>
To: Cara Lin <cara.lin@novahealth.io>, Rajesh Kumar <rajesh.k@novahealth.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodai.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 12:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discrepancy in post-show pipeline credit from May 6-7 roadshow

Hi Cara / Rajesh — thanks for the export. We ran a join and here are the high-level notes:

1) Canonicalization: our ingest strips role-based addresses (info@, hello@) unless they are tied to a unique badge scan with name metadata. That explains 2 records. We can relax that rule for sponsor reconciliation.
2) Influence window: we used a 45-day lookback for opp creation. The inbound SDR-created opp (3 days after the show) falls inside that window and should have been included; it appears we missed it due to an alternate email on the opportunity.
3) Manual matches: 3 leads had different email casing or plus-addressing variants (alice+bmktg@). The automated join failed on those; we can run a normalized match to include plus-address and lowercasing.

Action plan (short):
- I'll run a normalized join and relaxed role-address rule and produce an updated CSV by EOD today (recon_workbook_May2026.xlsx).
- Ben / Marissa will propose a small make-good: 3 lead credits to NovaHealth if we still find gaps after normalization.
- If you prefer a deterministic policy for future shows, we can draft a one-page attribution SLA for sponsors.

Can you confirm you want the credits or prefer to wait for the normalized join? We can also book a 20-min call at 9:30 PT tomorrow to walk through the workbook.

Thanks,
Monica Patel | Events Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodai.com | +1 415-555-0199
From: Cara Lin <cara.lin@novahealth.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodai.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Rajesh Kumar <rajesh.k@novahealth.io>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2026 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discrepancy in post-show pipeline credit from May 6-7 roadshow

Monica / Ben — thank you for the quick turnaround and clear plan. We reviewed the proposed approach and agree to the normalization and relaxed role-address rule. We accept the make-good of 3 lead credits if anything is still missing after your reconciliation.

Please send the finalized workbook and a short one-page attribution SLA we can include in our post-event sponsor packet. Once we sign off internally, we'll close this on our side. The 9:30 PT slot works for a quick walkthrough; I'll have Rajesh and our RevOps lead on.

Appreciate the partnership here — want to make sure our leadership sees a consistent process going forward.

Best,
Cara
Head of Demand, NovaHealth

Attachments referenced: novahealth_crm_export_May2026.csv
